title: JavaScript Basics
description: Introduction to variables, data types, and operators.

lessons.title: What is JavaScript?
lessons.content: JavaScript is a scripting language used to create dynamic content on websites.

lessons.title: Variables in JS
lessons.content: Variables are containers for storing data. Use `let`, `const`, or `var`.

title: Data Types and Conversion
description: Learn about different data types and how to convert between them.

lessons.title: Primitive Data Types
lessons.content: JavaScript has primitive types like string, number, boolean, null, undefined, and symbol.

title: Functions and Scope
description: Understanding functions, parameters, return values, and scope.

lessons.title: Defining Functions
lessons.content: Functions are reusable blocks of code that perform tasks.

lessons.title: Scope
lessons.content: Scope determines the accessibility of variables. Local scope is inside functions, global is outside.

title: Control Structures
description: Learn how to control the flow of your program with loops and conditionals.

lessons.title: If-Else Statements
lessons.content: Use if-else to run code based on conditions.

title: Arrays
description: Working with lists of data using arrays.

lessons.title: What is an Array?
lessons.content: Arrays store multiple values in a single variable.

title: Objects
description: Storing data with key-value pairs using objects.

title: ES6 Features
description: Modern JavaScript syntax: arrow functions, template literals, and destructuring.

title: Promises and Async
description: Handling asynchronous code with Promises and async/await.

lessons.title: What is a Promise?
lessons.content: Promises represent the eventual completion of async operations.

lessons.title: Async/Await Syntax

title: DOM Manipulation
description: Interacting with the Document Object Model using JavaScript.

title: Error Handling
description: Using try-catch blocks to handle errors gracefully.
